No. The evidence indicates tree-cover loss on about **81.3 hectares**, or **2.23%** of the 3,643.5-hectare property, in 2021—not the whole property. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in small patches below the event-size threshold.

Most of the mapped event area was classified as planted forest. The data do not establish whether the loss was caused by clearing, harvesting, fire or another cause.
